nameEn: Remediation activities and other waste management services
description: This class includes the provision of remediation services to contaminated sites, as well as other waste management services not elsewhere classified.
includes: cleaning up of contaminated buildings, mine sites, soil and ground water
cleaning up and restoring contaminated soil: contaminated land remediation
cleaning of polluted rivers, lakes, seas and ground water
asbestos, lead paint and other toxic material abatement
decontamination of soils and ground water at the place of pollution
decontamination of industrial plants and sites to allow for re-use
cleaning up oil spills and other pollution incidents
excludes: treatment and disposal of non-hazardous waste, see 3821
treatment and disposal of hazardous waste, see 3822
